# Sales Cookie Blog

> > Expert guidance on sales commission structures, quota setting, and performance management for modern sales teams.

Sales Cookie provides comprehensive resources on designing, automating, and managing sales commission programs. The blog covers commission calculation strategies, ASC 606 compliance, SPM vendor selection, CRM integration with Salesforce and HubSpot, and best practices for SaaS recurring revenue models.

## Key Topics

- Sales commissions
- Commission structures
- Quota setting and attainment
- ASC 606 revenue recognition
- Sales Performance Management (SPM)
- Commission automation
- SaaS recurring revenue
- CRM integration (Salesforce, HubSpot)
- GAAP compliance
- Sales incentive programs
- Commission calculation
- Independent sales reps
- Sales manager compensation
- Commission splitting
- MRR-based commissions

## Commission Program Design & Best Practices

- [Designing An Effective Sales Commission Program – Part 1](https://blog.salescookie.com/2019/03/03/designing-an-effective-sales-commission-program-part-1): Best practices for designing effective sales incentive programs
- [How To Calculate Sales Commissions Based On Recurring Revenue (SaaS)](https://blog.salescookie.com/2019/05/26/how-to-calculate-sales-commissions-based-on-recurring-revenue-saas): SaaS commission strategies for MRR & recurring revenue models
- [How To Split Sales Commissions](https://blog.salescookie.com/2019/06/01/how-to-split-sales-commissions): Methods for splitting commissions between reps & teams
- [Designing an Effective Commission Plan For Sales Managers](https://blog.salescookie.com/2019/02/19/designing-an-effective-commission-plan-for-sales-managers): Sales manager commission plan design for team performance metrics
- [Sales Commission Structures For Independent Reps](https://blog.salescookie.com/2019/07/16/sales-commission-structures-for-independent-reps): Commission-only compensation structures for independent contractors
- [Sales Commission Examples For Solar Sales](https://blog.salescookie.com/2020/08/07/sales-commission-examples-for-solar-sales): Solar sales commission structures & examples for canvassers & managers

## Quota Management & Sales Targets

- [How To Involve Your Reps When Setting Quotas](https://blog.salescookie.com/2020/09/16/how-to-involve-your-reps-when-setting-quotas): Top-down vs bottom-up quota setting strategies for sales teams
- [Setting Sales Targets Based On Growth](https://blog.salescookie.com/2019/07/03/setting-sales-targets-based-on-growth): Growth-based sales targets as alternative to traditional quotas
- [What Is Quota Retirement?](https://blog.salescookie.com/2024/04/30/what-is-quota-retirement): Quota retirement & attainment terminology explained with examples
- [YTD Vs. QTD Commission Plans](https://blog.salescookie.com/2020/11/16/ytd-vs-qtd-commission-plans): Comparing year-to-date vs quarter-to-date commission structures
